summary: Configured NFS export of /srv/nfs/shared on node1, mounted at /mnt/shared on node2, using a shared dataops identity (UID/GID 4500) with mode 2770 on both nodes. Verified cross-node consistent ownership by creating files from each side. Completed mandatory restart protocol on both nodes with proven boot-identity changes and post-restart recovery; discovered and fixed a persistence gap (missing netmount OpenRC service on node2) and validated the fix with a second reboot.
actions_performed: Created dataops user/group (UID/GID 4500) on node1 and node2
Created /srv/nfs/shared on node1, chown dataops:dataops, chmod 2770
Configured /etc/exports on node1 scoped to node2 IP 10.100.163.11, enabled+started rpcbind and nfs services
Created /mnt/shared on node2, added fstab entry with _netdev, enabled rpcbind, mounted the NFS export
Verified cross-node file creation as dataops shows consistent dataops:dataops ownership and 2770 perms from both sides
Captured baseline boot_id and service health on both nodes before restarts
Restarted node1 via background-scheduled reboot; polled until reachable; confirmed new boot_id, NFS server auto-started, export active, data intact
Verified node2 mount and read/write access still worked after node1 restart
Restarted node2; confirmed new boot_id; found NFS mount did not auto-remount because netmount was not enabled in the default OpenRC runlevel
Fixed by rc-update add netmount default on node2, remounted manually, verified access and data integrity
Restarted node2 a second time to validate the netmount fix persists; confirmed new boot_id and automatic NFS remount with full data integrity

nfs/rpcbind status started, export active, data files intact; node2 mount continued working against restarted server
Captured boot_id 9559b3fc-... and confirmed mount active with successful dataops write/list
